name: Dumbbell Cossack Squat
steps: Stand with feet much wider than shoulder width, toes turned slightly out, holding a dumbbell against your chest.
Shift onto one foot and sit your hips deep into a squat over that heel.
Keep your opposite leg straight, letting those toes rotate upward if helpful for depth.
Drive through the bent leg to return to center and alternate sides.
tips: Keep the heel of the squatting leg flat on the floor throughout.
Keep your chest lifted and descend only as far as you can control smoothly.
